features.name: p_value
features.description: The reported p-value for the study's primary association/result (e.g. 5.2e-8). If multiple are reported, use the primary/most significant one stated in the text.

features.name: countries
features.description: The country or countries the study participants are from (participant ancestry/recruitment origin, NOT the institution's location if different).

features.name: population_description
features.description: Free-text description of the study population as the authors describe it (e.g. ethnicity, ancestry, or cohort description such as 'Black South African').

features.name: sample_size
features.description: The number of participants in the study sample (total N used for the primary analysis).

features.name: mixed_population
features.description: true if the study sample combines participants from more than one distinct population/ethnicity/country; false if it is a single population. Absent if the text does not make this determinable.
